description:
The hospital is joining a national Health Information Exchange (HIE) program. As the IT administrator, you need to create a new Patient Identifier Type in the OpenMRS Administration panel so that registration staff can begin recording National Health IDs for patients.

Perform the following steps:

1. Navigate to the OpenMRS Administration interface (accessible via https://localhost/openmrs/admin/index.htm or through the app links).
2. Log in with username 'superman' and password 'Admin123' if prompted.
3. Under the 'Patients' section, click 'Manage Patient Identifier Types'.
4. Click 'Add Patient Identifier Type' to create a new identifier type.
5. Fill in the following fields:
   - Name: National Health ID
   - Description: Unique national health identifier issued by the Ministry of Health for the Health Information Exchange program
6. Leave all other fields at their defaults (no format, no validator, not required).
7. Save the new Patient Identifier Type.
